browse.command: ./mill -w server.runBackground browse --host=0.0.0.0 --port={bind_port} & pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null; rm -f "${MILL_OUTPUT_DIR:-out}/server/runBackground.dest/newest-pid"' EXIT; wait $pid

code-server.command: set -o pipefail; cmd="$(./mill show editors.vscode.codeServer.cmd --host=0.0.0.0 --port={bind_port} --base-address={external_https_proxy_url} | jq -r .)" && eval "exec $cmd"
